description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5945009734143 RELAY,ELECTROMAGNET: Line 0001 Qty 10 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0157 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
